scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,shop -c green,yellow "bun run --cwd api dev" "bun run --cwd demo-shop dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n api,shop -c green,yellow "bun run --cwd api start" "bun run --cwd demo-shop start"
scripts.start:docker: concurrently --kill-others -n api,shop,opencode -c green,yellow,cyan "bun run --cwd api start" "bun run --cwd demo-shop start" "opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4096"
